newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3906/3.3940 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3906/3.3940 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3890 to 3.3930 pounds bid and 3.3915 to 3.3980 offered in the interbank market on Sunday.

A survey of three actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3906 pounds bid and 3.3940 pounds offered. The averages compared to 3.3919 pounds bid and 3.3936 pounds offered on Wednesday, before the three-day weekend started on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388305 buy and 3.396317 sell.
